title: Orchestrated Erasure and Tokenization for Console Analytics
creator: Avery Nakamura
description: Implement a coordinated privacy-first pipeline for console usage analytics that supports reversible tokenization for internal metrics, irreversible deletion for customer data subject requests, and retention-based archival. This work covers ingestion paths (events API -> Kafka), ETL transforms (Beam jobs), storage layers (S3/Parquet, warehousing, search indices), and indexing backends. Goals are: 1) ensure PII fields are replaced or tokenized at the earliest safe boundary, 2) provide an auditable, orchestrated delete path that can hard-delete across all stores, and 3) expose admin tooling and webhooks for deletion confirmation and compliance reporting. Must meet GDPR/CCPA requirements and integrate with KMS-backed key rotation and audit logging.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc approved by Privacy & Security and Console PM
End-to-end deletion workflow can remove a target user's identifiers from event storage, search indices, and derived warehouses within configured SLA (72h for full purge)
Tokenization scheme implemented with KMS-backed key material and documented key rotation plan
Orchestration workflow (Temporal) tracks each deletion job with durable state and emits audit records to the compliance log bucket
Admin UI endpoint that can trigger ad-hoc deletion or preview affected datasets and returns preflight report
Automated tests that simulate deletion across ingestion -> storage -> analytics and validate no residual identifiers remain
Performance impact of tokenization is within 10% CPU/latency degradation on critical ingestion path
Monitoring dashboards show deletion throughput, failures, and time-to-completion and alert on regressions
tasks: Write PRD and high-level architecture diagrams (Confluence link in attachments)
Prototype tokenization library and KMS integration (dev branch)
Add transform stage to Beam pipeline to tokenise/strip PII fields at ingestion
Implement Temporal workflow for orchestrating multi-store erasure and retries
Extend indexer job to support delete-by-hash and tombstone reconciliation
Create migration to backfill tokenized values for hot 90-day window
Instrument audit log sink and retention for compliance evidence
Build admin console endpoint with preview and confirmation webhooks
End-to-end smoke tests and chaos tests for failure modes
Rollout plan: staged by org ID with canary, monitor, and automatic rollback
